targetText: It is perfectly obvious that not races but state organisations of definite groups of the bourgeoisie are conducting the struggle. It is also perfectly obvious that one or the other grouping of the great powers is determined, not by a community of certain racial tasks, but by a community of capitalist aims at a given moment.
summary: Bukharin demolishes racial theories of imperialism, showing that military alliances follow capitalist profit interests rather than racial identity.
explanation: Pointing to multi-ethnic war coalitions and shifting alliances among European and Asian powers, Bukharin exposes racial ideology as a ruling-class fabrication designed to mask the war aims of finance capital.
